question: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)

calls.reasoning: VIX fell to ~17-17.8 on Nov 4 after the Democratic midterm sweep removed election uncertainty (down ~16-17%). The regime has been jumpy: mid-Oct spike above 22, Oct 30 intraday 22.31 (highest since April), ~20.5-21 around election day. Base rate: the 10-day max intraday high is typically 5-15% above the starting level, giving a median ~19 from a start near 17. Post-event vol crush could push spot to 15-16 before Nov 9 (downside); I assume CPI (~Nov 12-13), Nvidia earnings and VIX expiry (~Nov 18-19) fall inside the window, though I did not confirm those dates this run, and November VIX call buying targeted 23+ (upside). No human prediction market found (Kalshi activity is midterm-focused; harness found none on Polymarket/Manifold). No escape mass above 50: it would need a crash-level shock.

calls.reasoning: VIX fell to about 17.1 on Nov 4 after the post-midterm vol crush (from a 20.83 close on Nov 3). The reference class of 10-trading-day maximum highs runs about 1.10-1.15x the starting spot at the median, with a fat right tail, which puts the median near 19. Upside: the Nasdaq-100 is in a correction, VIX spiked to about 22-24 intraday in October, and CPI, Nvidia earnings and expiry are probably in the window. Downside: the event premium is gone and realized vol is about 11.8, so VIX could drift to 16 before Nov 9. No human market found on Kalshi, Polymarket or Manifold.
calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: the Oct 30 intraday high (22.31 vs 23.93) could not be settled without web access, but both show low-to-mid-20s autumn spikes, so the tail is treated the same either way. Run 3's detailed bar for Nov 3 (close 20.83) agrees with Run 2, so Run 1's 20.51 is likely wrong; the difference is immaterial. In-window catalyst dates are unverified, so there is some chance they fall outside the window. The judgment dispute is the start level on Nov 9: given the post-election analog (Nov 2024 drift lower) and low realized vol, I expect a start of about 16.5-17.5, which gives a median near 18.9, closer to Runs 1 and 2. I kept a fat right tail because of the Nasdaq correction regime. I carried forward the shared reference class and Runs 2/3's dispersion (~9).
